title: Nine Sols Interactive Map

Metadata.title: Nine Sols Interactive Map
Metadata.description:
To save you time finding that last item in an area.

An interactive map for Nine Sols with all items, map chips, bosses and more!

map-error: The map could not load. Please try again.
copy-error: Could not copy the link. Please try again.
about-description: An interactive map for finding items, bosses, and missed areas in Nine Sols. Created and maintained by gtarraga.
about-use: Filter by marker type, then select a marker for its description and any tips. Copy its URL to share that location. Use “Show all markers” to return to the full map.
about-corrections: Found a missing marker or an incorrect description? Report it on GitHub.
about-support: Ko-fi contributions help cover hosting costs.
privacy-intro: Nine Sols Map is maintained by gtarraga. You can use the map without an account.
privacy-analytics: We use PostHog, hosted in the EU, to understand how the map is used. It collects page visits, interactions, browser and device information, and IP addresses. The current setup uses first-party cookies and browser storage to distinguish visitors and sessions. Cookieless tracking is not currently enabled. Session recordings may be collected when enabled in the analytics project.
privacy-hosting: Vercel hosts the site, Cloudflare handles network delivery and the analytics proxy, and Supabase stores public marker data. These services process network information, such as IP addresses, to deliver the site. Browsing the map does not require signing in to Supabase.
privacy-ads: We use Google AdSense to display ads. Google and other advertising partners may collect page URLs, IP addresses, browser information and identifiers, and may use cookies or web beacons to serve and measure ads. Where personalized ads are available, they may be based on visits to this and other sites. You can manage personalized advertising through Google My Ad Center. Closing the banner lasts until reload and does not save a preference.
privacy-choices: You can clear site cookies and browser storage through your browser settings. For questions about privacy or requests concerning your data, contact the maintainer through the project’s GitHub issues. Do not include private information in a public issue.
locations-intro: Browse the same marker descriptions used by the map, grouped by type. Select a location to read its note and see its position on the map. Descriptions may contain spoilers.
location-unavailable: Location notes are temporarily unavailable. You can still try loading the map.
location-empty: No additional note has been added for this location.
